name: application-org-headcount-chart
title: Org Headcount Chart
description: Department headcount bar chart with an open-roles overlay segment — bar widths are computed from real filled/open numbers relative to the largest department, distinct from org-chart, which visualizes reporting hierarchy rather than headcount totals.
useWhen: Comparing headcount across departments alongside how many roles are still open in each.
You want bar proportions computed from real numbers, not hand-styled per department.
A legend distinguishing filled vs open roles adds necessary context to the bars.
avoidWhen: You need to show individual reporting relationships between people — use org-chart instead.
There are no open roles to overlay — a plain segment-breakdown-bar or bar chart is simpler.
You need per-person detail, not department aggregates — use a table instead.
responsiveBehavior: Bars are full-width within their container and scale fluidly; the legend wraps onto a new line at narrow widths.
accessibility: Each bar segment (filled and open) carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the department and the exact count, since segment width alone isn't announced by screen readers.
Open roles are distinguished from filled roles by both a dashed border and a lighter fill, not color alone.
The legend below the chart explicitly labels what each bar segment style means.

variants.title: Org headcount chart
variants.description: Four departments (Engineering, Sales, Design, Support) with filled headcount bars and dashed open-roles overlays, on a light surface.
accessibility: Support has zero open roles, demonstrating that the open-roles segment simply doesn't render rather than showing a zero-width sliver.

variants.title: Org headcount chart (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-department headcount chart, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Bar and outline colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
